title: Spain to Extend Ceuta Maritime Barriers from 17 November
detail: Government delegate David De La Encina announced that work begins 17 November at Tarajal and Benzu to extend existing sea barriers 150 m seaward and add anti-climb mesh and floating barriers over about 500 m, at a cost of roughly €5 million. A completion date was not announced.

media.caption: Spain to extend maritime barriers at Ceuta
